baseline.frontend: Built from isolated git archive of HEAD 957d90c430d2f1ed199fe875ae646987395411ff; current worktree artifact was not used.
baseline.imageValidation: Each PNG signature and IHDR dimensions checked from file bytes; SHA-256 recorded per entry.
baseline.buildSource: git archive HEAD from target worktree; source revision 957d90c430d2f1ed199fe875ae646987395411ff
baseline.screenshotCapture: OMP-managed Chromium, PNG bytes copied from screenshot output file (not temporary path strings).

data.description: Synthetic only: three category folders, one indexed root course (library) with nine generated media files; four progress records and four notes seeded via authenticated study APIs. No external course files or passwords in captures.

empty.description: No library root configured; catalog API returned zero nodes. Empty state is real.

fixtures.stopInstruction: Stop service learnvault-baseline-runner; it forwards SIGTERM to both server children and leaves temporary fixture files for inspection.

reference.comparison: Identical byte-level SHA-256 for Downloads full HTML and canonical full HTML; isolated board files rendered read-only and cropped to .screen.

limitations: Settings has no data-dependent state; its “data” and “empty” entries are the same settings composition captured against both fixture server states.
The staged import form is the real HTTP import form before submit; no fake error or preview was inserted.
These captures document the original graphite baseline and are not approval of visual fidelity.
Reference board PNG dimensions are the cropped .screen element and can exceed the CSS viewport; both are stored per entry.
Before PNGs were captured from an isolated build of the recorded HEAD, not the mutable current worktree build.
Populated screenshots were captured only after catalog/activity/note data had rendered (course-linked notes and actual persisted progress). Empty analytics waited for the real no-activity state.
